annotated_by: draft, not yet reviewed by a second person
purpose: Clear, explicit wording in all five categories.

passages.quote: At the end of the free trial, your membership will automatically convert to a paid subscription unless you cancel before the trial ends.
passages.note: Conversion wording. Trial length (14 days) is in the preceding sentence.

passages.quote: Your subscription will automatically renew for successive periods of one month until you cancel.
passages.note: Automatic renewal with a one-month period.

passages.quote: The subscription fee is $9.99 per month, charged to your payment method on each renewal date.
We may change the subscription fee by giving you at least 30 days' notice by email.
passages.note: Stated price-change term. Not a conflict with the fee passage.

passages.quote: You may cancel at any time in Account Settings.
Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.
Payments are non-refundable, and we do not provide refunds for partially used billing periods.
passages.note: Refund term stating that refunds are not given.
